summary: Inspected all supplied handoff support (handoff.md, source.py, decision-log.md, scenario-input.json, task.md) in fresh context. The predecessor's recommendation to continue rests on an unverified caller-compatibility assumption that decision-log.md requires reconciled; no caller inventory exists, so reconciliation cannot complete. The format change to v2 (revision 8) materializes the risk. Policy selected: FRESH CONTEXT REQUIRED; continuation on the predecessor handoff is not safe and the unverified assumption is kept out of parent acceptance.
gaps: No caller inventory was supplied; caller-compatibility with the new v2 output format cannot be verified.
The assumption 'the old parser output remains accepted by all callers' is explicitly unverified (handoff.md line 4) and could not be confirmed.
No call-site evidence was available to inspect; reconciliation of caller compatibility was therefore not possible.
The parent's frozen evaluator checks could not be executed in-scope (no shell/evaluator tooling available); conditions were verified directly via grep/glob/read instead.
